  MINUTES
  CLAIMS REVIEW COMMITTEE
  August 26, 2019

A meeting of the Claims Review Committee was held in the Council Chambers, 9th floor at
11:50 a.m.:

  Members Present: Yvonne Horton, City Clerk Department
  Debbie Crenshaw, Treasure’s Department
  Maria Heaney, Finance Department

  Staff Present:  Toya Ferguson, Finance Department

Public Comments Regarding Agenda Items
  Member Heaney reported no public comments.

  1. The minutes of August 12, 2019, meeting was approved as recorded.

  2. Alta Environmental – A motion was moved and seconded to approve the recommended
  settlement payment of $5,228.48. Motion carried unanimously.

Public Comments Regarding Other Matters
  Member Heaney reported no public comments.

  There being no further business, the meeting adjourned at 11:57 a.m.

Adjournment
